meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. An apology isn't a basis for a mark, though. What is the zero resting on, Hale?
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, when, and under which section? Procedure 4.4 says nothing goes in the record on a first concern, and you've just told me you did it anyway. It comes off today, in writing, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done and then it's the board.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
A note in a student file means something to whoever reads it, Hale, and Claire's file taught me that. I'm writing down "it's just a note." I asked who, when, and under which section, so answer that.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn and the note removed from Owen's file today, in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She went back to her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, the note off his file, and an answer on who put it there; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out before you got there.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before anyone called her, in one sentence, without defending it, and that earned a flat okay because you took the process on yourself.
What cost ground: You told her the concern was already in his file and then called it just a note, which hit the one thing she never trades and put you against procedure 4.4 in her own printed copy.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never got near that night because you showed none about the essay, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what the zero rested on, answer with something dated that she can check herself, instead of moving to the file.
